sources.title: 98 Languages, Local — Korean, Japanese, Chinese & More | MacParakeet
sources.snippet: Parakeet is the everyday default, WhisperKit is for broader language coverage, and Cohere Transcribe is an optional local batch engine for plain-text file transcription. Is my audio still on-device with optional engines? Yes. WhisperKit, Cohere Transcribe, and Parakeet all run locally after their model files are downloaded.

sources.title: Local Voice-AI Model Database: Self-Hosted STT & TTS, License-Graded (2026)
sources.snippet: DCENT_Voice now demonstrates a fully local hybrid stack: CC-BY-4. Parakeet TDT 0.6B v3 runs by default through CPU ONNX; MIT-licensed faster-whisper supplies the bundled multilingual offline fallback; whisper.cpp remains an optional engine. Kyutai's streaming STT is natively English-plus-French — the exact Canadian language pair.
